capabilities: decrypt .skenc files with a master password
set and change a single master password
mark encrypted files with lock icons in the file explorer
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain local files with no built-in way to encrypt sensitive ones.
summary: File-encryption plugin that encrypts individual vault files to .skenc format with AES-256-GCM under a single master password.
